metadata.title: बाथौ धर्म में बड़े बदलाव, बन रहे हैं मंदिर | The Transformation of Bathou Religion | Main Bhi Bharat
metadata.description: Main Bhi Bharat brings you a special ground report on the changing face of Bathou religion, the traditional faith of the Bodo community. Once rooted in simple nature worship around the sacred Siju plant, Bathouism is now witnessing a transformation with the rise of organised Thansalis (temples), priestly systems, and collective rituals. Alongside, the influence of Hinduism and Christianity has reshaped practices, while revivalist movements are striving to preserve its indigenous essence. This report captures voices from the ground on how faith, identity, and modernity are redefining religion for the Bodos today.
